_readme: CustomerOps (COPS-07) alerts. The source of truth is Terraform: deploy/gcp/terraform/monitoring.tf creates the log-based metrics, the alert policies, the email channel and the in-app webhook channel in GCP Cloud Monitoring. This file only lists the four alerts and where each is defined; it defines nothing itself, so there is no second set to drift. The GCP versions replace the earlier Datadog log monitors (Aditya, 2026-10-14: Datadog is not used; the Datadog definitions are in git history). How to apply: docs/ops/gcp-monitoring.md.

alerts.name: [CustomerOps] A workflow health metric is critical
[CustomerOps] A workflow health metric is in warning
[CustomerOps] The health report has stopped
alerts.note: Off by default (var.alert_on_missing_health_report): the staging VM is stopped overnight and at weekends.

alerts.name: [CustomerOps] The health report itself is failing
